Subject: Intro: Infra team sync + schedule confirmation (AE, SE, Eng Lead)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call with us last week. I wanted to get an initial technical discovery on the calendar so our SE (Stephanie) can walk through the integration surface and our engineers can understand procurement/security requirements up front.

Proposed 45-minute windows (PST):
- Tue Jan 11, 9:00–9:45am
- Tue Jan 11, 11:30–12:15pm
- Wed Jan 12, 8:30–9:15am

Could you confirm which of those works for you and who from Peco should join? It'd be ideal to have your engineering lead and a procurement/security contact on the call so we can capture requirements and next steps (SOC2, data flow, retention).

Agenda (draft):
1) Intros + scope (5m)
2) Architecture & data flow (20m)
3) Security/compliance checklist & timelines (10m)
4) Next steps / mutual action plan (10m)

I've attached a short agenda doc and a checklist we typically use to speed procurement reviews.

If none of those slots work, share some times and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Priya (our engineering lead) and Ben (procurement) are looped. We have a calendar conflict on Jan 11 morning for the first two slots; Wed Jan 12 8:30–9:15am PST should work for Priya and me.

Ben, can you confirm if procurement will join that session or if you'd prefer a separate procurement-only call afterward? If you want to join the same, we'll keep the compliance segment tight.

Also quick ask: do you have any NDA/PO templates to review ahead of time? Helps speed legal.

Thanks —
